notes.title: Spooky Mansion Manager is out NOW!
notes.notes:
[i]I guess you got the news already. My condolences on your Grandpa. Looking on the bright side he did leave you the business and the Mansion. Plenty of work to be done now.[/i]

And we’re out! I hope you enjoy Spooky Mansion Manager! I’ve also written a guide (in English) which can be accessed through the Community page in case you get really stuck or feel like checking spoilers (shame shame shame!). Have fun you aspiring entrepreneur you!

Sikari-S
Saksorb

notes.title: Spooky Mansion Manager releasing in two days!
notes.notes:
[i]Have you checked on your Grandpa in a while? I haven’t heard anything in a hot minute. I better go check on him. I’ll get back to you![/i]

Release of Spooky Mansion Manager is coming closer! We’ve been adding localizations left and right and now support Deutsch, English, Español-Latinoamérica, Français, Italiano, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Português-Brasil and Suomi.

The release is on 1st of September around 7:00 AM PDT for the convenience of morning people.

Sikari-S
Saksorb
